note: Candidate families per track. Each family is one ecbench ic.pipeline oracle string on the track's factor-base template; the searched knob is N (the base size, {n}; {scan} = scan_factor x N). Every family here is an existing lab method; a new family that needs code is a source change and gets its own round after the build. default_f sets the first base size as a fraction of N_a = round(0.63 r^(1/3)). Disable a family rather than deleting it, so the history stays readable. A family's own n_min (when set) overrides the track's: a k-sum table needs more base points than summands. The generic n_grid gained 0.85 and 1.2 after round 6 (the optimum sat between grid points).
